method: Commons category/subcategory batches up to100 files as two50-file imageinfo requests; descriptive User-Agent,maxlag5 and approximately1.1-second pacing. Prior candidate titles excluded.
notes: Whole-car selections checked individually after contact sheets; approximately5%margin and aspect1.4-1.7. No cropping/padding/artificial image edits.

Honda Integra and Orthia photographs show representative family members, not exact unverified technical versions. Fiat131 photograph shows two cars of the same family, with the gold foreground vehicle selected as the subject.
Jaguar E-Type selection is specifically SeriesI roadster, not transferred to coupe or2+2 records. No F-Type photograph accepted from tight candidates.
Some Commons categories contain unrelated objects or cars. Such candidates were rejected; category alone was not treated as model identification.
Photo searches remain incomplete. Null means no accepted reference yet, not absence of suitable Commons photographs.
